title: M6-Lite task manifest
description: One real task of the M6-Lite task set, as frozen by the independent curator (ADR-004 section 2). The task set is secret until launch; this schema fixes what a manifest contains, so that the launch check can verify shape and digests without reading the content. Validated and linted by tools/test-task-schema.py.

task_id.description: Opaque identifier chosen by the curator; it must reveal nothing about the task.

prompt.description: The exact statement handed to the agent. Identical in both arms; any wording difference between arms is a protocol violation.

project.description: The external project the starting code comes from.

licence.description: Permissive licences only (ADR-004 section 2); the code must also sit inside the pure TypeScript subset of ts-to-dafny.md.

revision.description: Commit, tag or archive the code was taken from.

files.description: The starting code, path by path, each with its sha256 digest.

modifiable.description: The only paths the agent may change. A submission touching anything else is refused by the controller. Paths are relative and may not contain '..'.

obligations.description: The frozen Obligation Set for this task, written by the curator and read-only for the agent.

oracle.description: Digest of the frozen oracle for this task. The oracle itself lives only in the private evaluation repository and is never shipped with the task.

max_minutes.description: Per-run wall-clock limit, fixed by ADR-004 section 3.

max_model_calls.description: Per-run model-call limit, retries and automatic summaries included; fixed by ADR-004 section 3. A runner that cannot measure it refuses the official launch.

path.description: A relative path whose segments contain no '.' or '..'.
